name: aember
description: Work in Aember, the Mac code editor that records every change to your project, yours and Claude's, so you can undo any one of them. Opens the session's project in Aember and has Claude read, search and edit through Aember's tools.

open_projects.title: Open projects in Aember
open_projects.description: When a session starts in a git repository or an Aember project, open it in Aember, launching Aember in the background if it isn't running. Off: only sessions in projects already open in Aember are told about it.

route_file_tools.title: Route file tools through Aember
route_file_tools.description: Refuse Claude Code's own Read, Edit, Write and Grep on the files of a project open in Aember, so Claude uses Aember's tools and every change is recorded. Read still opens images, PDFs and other files that aren't text.

mcp_url.title: Aember MCP server
mcp_url.description: The address in the Endpoint row of Aember's Settings > MCP. Change it only if Aember's server isn't on the usual port.

aember_app.title: Aember app
aember_app.description: The Aember.app to launch when Aember isn't running. Empty: /Applications/Aember.app, else any copy of Aember.
